reviewStatus: 704 named sprites in 88 designs. All four questioned families resolved with user-selected descriptive names (32 sprites); jug/vase and scepter/spoon remain intentionally searchable alternatives.

conventions.layout: 88 rows of eight colour variants. Rows 19-78 are six key-head families times ten tooth patterns.
conventions.naming: Preserve original stem; append object, shape/features, then appearance-based colour. Bit01-Bit10 give stable searchable tooth-pattern identifiers.
conventions.uncertainty: User accepted Decanter, FancyJugOrVase, Cross and ScepterOrSpoon. No outstanding naming decisions.
